info.name: Noon Marketplace — Customer API
info.description:
Customer-facing API for the Noon marketplace backend.

Generated from `routes/api_customer.php` and `routes/api_customer_v1.php`, with every URL, query and body parameter taken from the matching FormRequest / inline validator in `app/Http/Requests/Customer`, `app/Http/Requests/Api/Customer` and the controllers themselves.

## Getting started

1. Run **01 · Auth → Login (saves access_token)**. Its test script writes `access_token`, `refresh_token` and `customer_id` into collection variables.
2. Every authenticated request inherits collection-level Bearer auth using `{{access_token}}`, so it just works from that point on.
3. Public endpoints are explicitly set to **No Auth** and are labelled as such in their description.

## Routing

- Country-scoped routes: `{{base_url}}/api/customer/v1/{{country}}/…` — the `detect.country` middleware resolves the `{country}` site code into a `Country` model.
- Country-agnostic routes: `{{base_url}}/api/customer/v1/…` — the country comes from the authenticated customer or the `X-Country-Id` header.

## Useful headers

| Header | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}}` | JWT for the `customer` guard. Applied automatically. |
| `X-Listing-Type` | Dual-mode catalogue switch: `marketplace` (vendor listings) or `nawy_now` (admin listings). |
| `X-Cart-Token` | Guest cart identifier for the unauthenticated cart flow. |
| `X-Country-Id` | Country UUID fallback on country-agnostic public routes. |
| `Accept-Language` | `ar` or `en`. Defaults to the country default. |

request.description:
Register a new customer account. Throttled to 10 requests/min.

`POST {{base_url}}/api/customer/v1/{{country}}/auth/register`

**Auth:** Public — no token required

#### URL path parameters

| Key | Required | Type | Values | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `country` | Yes | string | `uae`, `ksa`, `egy`, `kwt`, `qat`, `omn`, `bhr`, `jor` | Country site code resolved by the `detect.country` middleware. |

#### Body parameters (JSON)

| Key | Required | Type | Values | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | Yes | string | — | Customer full name. |
| `email` | Yes | string | — | Unique email address. Must not already exist on `customers.email`. |
| `phone` | No | string | — | Unique phone number (max 20 chars). |
| `password` | Yes | string | — | Account password, minimum 8 characters. Must be confirmed. |
| `password_confirmation` | Yes | string | — | Must exactly match `password`. |
| `referral_code` | No | string | — | Referral code of an existing customer, exactly 8 characters. |
